contexts: harmful drinking recorded for 131 of 412 admissions
reading: The pathway runs from admission, through a period when the patient becomes well enough to talk, to a short window for two sessions before an often abrupt discharge, and then to a follow-up call that about half of patients answer. Each step can fail for reasons unrelated to the intervention's value: detention, short stays, ward workload and lost phone numbers. The retrieved evidence gives planning values for delivery (c1), follow-up (c2) and acceptability (c3); the lead presented as a landmark trial is unverified and plays no part.
